title: GitHub App manifest (replicant profile)
description: WS-07. Validates Replicant's GitHub App manifest against the parameters documented at https://docs.github.com/en/apps/sharing-github-apps/registering-a-github-app-from-a-manifest (checked 2026-10-24), plus replicant policy: private app, least privilege, no workflows/administration/secrets permissions. Event/permission compatibility is cross-checked by validate_manifest.py.

request_oauth_on_install.description: Replicant policy: identity linking uses its own OAuth link flow from the control plane (identity.md §4.2), not install-time OAuth.

public.description: Replicant policy: registrations are private to the owning org/account.

default_permissions.$comment: Deliberately absent (forbidden by additionalProperties): workflows, administration, secrets, actions, environments, organization_administration, repository_hooks, emails. Replicant never edits .github/workflows (D-21).
